content.text:
I implemented `tax_for` in `src/billing/tax.py`, but it rounds half-even, not half-up. The project memory records a decision with the finance team (March 2026) to use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) for tax, and it says not to use half-up.
